spans.s: मैनवी [mainavī], (In music) A kind of gait or movement.

मैनाकः [mainākḥ], [मेनकायां भवः अण्] N. of a mountain, son of Himālaya and Menā, who alone retained his wings (when Indra clipped those of other mountains) on account of his friendship with the ocean; cf.
; चिरं जलनिधौ मग्नो मैनाक इव मार्दवम् Bv. -Comp. -स्वसृ f. epithet of Pārvatī.
मैन्दः [maindḥ], N. of a demon killed by Kṛiṣṇa. -Comp. -हन् m. an epithet of Kṛiṣṇa.
